NextGen Mobile Suite provides a comprehensive, centralized digital hub designed to deliver high-performance mobility tools, identity verification, encrypted data storage, and citizen/user utilities directly to Android devices.

Built using modern cross-platform native frameworks, the application operates both online and offline. Cryptographic public-key signatures ensure all downloaded credentials and digital cards remain tamper-evident and securely authenticated.

How to Host this Page & APK for Free on GitHub

Follow these 4 simple steps to host this exact landing page on GitHub Pages with 100% free uptime and direct APK downloads:

1

Create a GitHub Repository

Go to github.com/new and create a public repository named my-app-portal.

2

Upload index.html

Upload this file as index.html directly into the root branch (main).

3

Upload your APK to GitHub Releases (Best Practice)

In your repository, click Releases → Draft a new release. Tag it v2.4.1 and drag-and-drop your compiled app-release.apk file (GitHub handles multi-gigabyte releases with fast worldwide CDN). Copy the direct download link of the APK and paste it into the Settings button on this page.

4

Enable GitHub Pages

Go to Settings → Pages in your repository. Under "Build and deployment", set source to Deploy from a branch, select main / / (root), and click Save. Your page will be live at:
https://<your-username>.github.io/my-app-portal/
